mission.display_title: Construct confidence intervals for a binomial probability and a Poisson mean
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to construct confidence intervals for a binomial probability and a Poisson mean, including Normal approximation in both cases — so discrete-parameter CIs are usable — without pretending two-sample CIs (3.2.6) are finished.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force binomial-probability and Poisson-mean CI construction (including Normal approximation) and refuse treating two-sample intervals as today's LO.
mission.educational_intent: Produce cognitive moves for binomial-probability and Poisson-mean confidence intervals, including Normal approximation under CMP conditions.
mission.learning_objective: Confidence intervals for a binomial probability and a Poisson mean, including the use of the normal approximation in both cases.
mission.concept_focus: Binomial p CI → Poisson mean CI → Normal approx → refuse two-sample-as-done.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday you formed Normal mean and variance CIs (3.2.4). Today continues topic 3.2 at LO 3.2.5 — binomial and Poisson intervals.
mission.why_now: 3.2.5 is contiguous after Normal recipes. Closing it prevents a cliff at discrete-parameter intervals while keeping two-sample CIs as day six.
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for binomial/Poisson CIs — not Topic Complete for 3.2.6.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Lambda Day 5 because Continuity Front membership places binomial/Poisson CIs after Normal mean/variance.
